title: Digital Marketing Professional
description: SBC Tanzania Limited is recruiting one Digital Marketing Professional to manage digital campaigns, paid media, agency delivery and consumer engagement.

Plan campaign schedules, audiences, channels and budgets. Deliver campaigns on Meta, Google/YouTube and TikTok. Brief and manage agencies, vendors and influencers. Set performance measures and tracking, monitor spending and optimise results weekly. Coordinate approvals and brand compliance with brand, sales, trade marketing, legal and finance teams.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, plus 5–6 years of experience managing digital campaigns and paid media. FMCG, beverage or consumer-brand experience is preferred.

Experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GA4 and reporting dashboards. Strong creative briefing, vendor negotiation, influencer management and analytical skills. Provide a portfolio showing campaign budgets, results and lessons learned.
Submit your application documents as one PDF to sbc-recruitment@sbc.co.tz. Use Digital Marketing Professional as the email subject. Applications close on 19 November 2026.
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. SBC Tanzania Limited is an equal opportunity employer.
verificationNote: Daraja owner confirmed the vacancy as verified and explicitly approved publication on 16 November 2026.
